name: @sjawhar/dispatch
//: test: each bun test command's --timeout is at least twice the slowest row or hook it ran under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs at 61b66deb (two builds Jobs) or on CI.
test:web, 10000: every document of the table reads in a DOM as the table says it reads, 4,299.70 ms (the slowest hook 390 ms).

e2e/__tests__, 60000: the pull-request lane stays inside its budget, and inside its real-stack share, 29,450.42 ms over 20 green merge-group runs on CI (9,898.28 ms under the loops, where the slowest row was no row runs twice in one configuration, 13,500.67 ms).

scripts.test: bun run build:contracts && bun run test:web web/src && bun test --parallel --timeout 60000 --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline e2e/__tests__
scripts.e2e: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:clock: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium-alone --project=firefox-alone --project=webkit-alone --workers=1
scripts.e2e:embedder: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_E2E_EMBEDDER=fake playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium search-tiers
scripts.e2e:multiprocess: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_BUILD=e2e-b vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --outDir dist-b && DISPATCH_E2E_PROCESSES=2 DISPATCH_E2E_EMBEDDER=1 DISPATCH_E2E_WEB_DIST_B=${DISPATCH_E2E_WEB_DIST_B:-../dispatch/web/dist-b} playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:deployed: bun run build:contracts && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:stub: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub --project=stub-phone
scripts.e2e:stub:record: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_E2E_STUB_RECORD=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub --project=stub-phone
